chapter: Maple Leaf, own orchestra and rivals
title: Fate Marable's riverboat bands; working until 1925 and then insurance
summary: He played as extra with Marable's boat bands but declined a regular spot, and after his 1925 illness sold insurance until 1940.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: What about the Boat, Fait Marable's band? Did you play with them ever? Not with Fred, no.
I played with Maitway. Oh I see. Whenever he had, you know, next year, then we played out, the band played on there too, the Silver Deef band.
Would you go substitute for Fait's band? Was he the regular band? No, no. Or would it be something special? How'd that work? No, see they used two bands.

And whenever they used two bands, well then I'd play with the other bands. Not Fait Marable. Or else when would they hire us too? They'd hire us as an extra band on the Sydney or whatever you call it. They had two bands. Capital. Capital, yeah. One time they tried to get me on there regularly, but I wouldn't go. Why not? I couldn't see nothing else but I had to work. Because it looked like that was the only guarantee that I thought it was in the music line those days. And like I told you I worked until 1918 without stopping. 1918 when the war, when the Amistad was signed, that's the time I quit working. Besides that, all the rest of the world I used to work. And when I got sick in 1925 and I quit playing music, I worked insurance. I worked for the Standing Insurance Company up until 1940 when I came here. I worked 16 years for this.
